clusters.pattern: adjust_from_feedback: log-call-only edits (message clobbers/case/None, extra dict removed or keys renamed, old_thresholds=None feeding only the log, dropped decay_factor kwarg restored by default)
clusters.note: Pure log content; no caplog assertions in the covering test file; nobody should assert these strings.

clusters.pattern: _apply_adjustment: mutations absorbed by the redundant clamp+cascade chain (bound widenings 0→1/100→101, overflow-branch arithmetic and sign flips, dead underflow-guard off-by-ones, final cap/floor widenings) — provably output-identical for every input
clusters.note: The final clamp pass plus ordering cascades re-derive the same (L,M,H) the branch mutations never alter; the `new_low < 0` branch is dead code. Flag as code-simplification candidate for the module owner.

clusters.pattern: reset_calibration: log-call-only edits (message clobbers, extra=None/removal, key renames, old_thresholds=None)
clusters.note: Same reasoning as the adjust_from_feedback log cluster.

clusters.pattern: calculate_adjustment: magnitude/boundary constants reachable but only inequality-asserted (base 10→11, min-adjust guard df>0→df>1, clamp body 1→2, FP/MT score-factor floor 1.0→2.0, /50→*50, score consts 50→51/100→101, SEVERITY_WRONG //2→//3 and //2→/2 float, zero-decay branch, direction boundary >=50→>50/>=51)
clusters.note: Tests in backend/tests/unit/services/test_calibration_service.py (TestCalculateAdjustment, ~lines 279-453) assert only signs/inequalities at scores 25/50/75/90 and decay 0/0.01/0.1/0.5/1.0; no exact-delta value test exists. Killed by drafted exact-value parametrize table.

clusters.pattern: get_thresholds: query-construction clobbers (stmt=None, where(None), select(None), ==→!= filter, execute(None)) that crash before any observable return
clusters.note: Self-crashing mutants: they raise (AttributeError/SQL compile) on every path — no behavior difference to assert; with mocked-session tests the !=-filter variant never even compiles.

clusters.pattern: calculate_adjustment: original_risk_score=risk_score → None in all five return branches
clusters.note: Pass-through field consumed only by the log payload; no caller behavior depends on it. Drafted test 1's trailing assert kills them for free.

clusters.pattern: _apply_adjustment: boundary values that actually change output (early/final low clamp max(0)→max(1), overflow magnitude new_high-100→new_high+100, final low cap min(90)→min(85), final high floor 2*GAP→3*GAP)
clusters.note: Existing TestApplyAdjustment asserts (>=0, <=100, strict ordering) pass for all mutants; hand-traced exact-tuple kills e.g. _apply(10,40,70,-50)==(0,5,20), _apply(95,100,100,0)==(90,95,100), _apply(0,5,12,0)==(0,5,12).

clusters.pattern: get_thresholds: is_calibrated = fp>0 or mt>0 → and / fp>1 / mt>1 (single-counter feedback case)
clusters.note: Tests at test_calibration_service.py:187 (counts 3+2→True) and :217 (0+0→False) never use exactly one counter == 1.

clusters.pattern: calculate_adjustment: clamp-guard widenings base<1 → <=1 / <2 (guard body is the constant 1, so no input distinguishes)
clusters.note: Guard firing at base 0 or 1 both assign 1.

clusters.pattern: adjust_from_feedback: feedback counter updates += 1 → = 1 (false_positive and missed_threat branches)
clusters.note: Both existing tests start counts at 0 where +=1 ≡ =1; no accumulation test exists.

clusters.pattern: adjust_from_feedback: updated_at = datetime.now(UTC) → None / now(None) naive
clusters.note: Nullable non-deterministic timestamp; contract is only 'a value is set'; freezegun smoke test optional.

clusters.pattern: adjust_from_feedback: user_id argument to get_or_create_calibration clobbered to None / omitted
clusters.note: Single-user deployment always passes 'default', so None/omitted collapse onto the same behavior in production.

drafted_tests.gist: Parametrized exact-delta table (9 rows: FP score-30 at df 0.05/0.1/0.19; FP 55@df1.0→11; MT 45@1.0→-11, 1@1.0→-19, 50@1.0→-10; SW 75@1.0→5, 75@0.5→2, 50@0.5→2, 75@0.0→0) plus original_risk_score echo assert; pins every magnitude/boundary constant in calculate_adjustment
drafted_tests.kills_cluster: C4 (calculate_adjustment magnitude/boundary constants, 17) plus C5 for free (original_risk_score=None, 5)

drafted_tests.gist: Parametrized exact-tuple asserts at reachable clamp boundaries: (10,40,70,-50)==(0,5,20), (95,100,100,0)==(90,95,100), (90,95,100,0)==(90,95,100), (0,5,12,0)==(0,5,12) — kills the five mutants whose altered constants survive inequality-only asserts
Calibration seeded with false_positive_count=5 / missed_threat_count=4; after one FALSE_POSITIVE assert count==6, after one MISSED_THREAT assert count==5 — kills +=1→=1 pinning mutants
Parametrized (fp=1,mt=0) and (fp=0,mt=1) mocked calibrations; assert thresholds.is_calibrated is True — kills the or→and and >0→>1 predicate mutants
